problems.proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  let E j := (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)
  let B j s := ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x
  let K := (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i)
  have hEs (j) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (E j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd (j k) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt (j) : Differentiable ℝ (B j) :=
    Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ K :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  have hρ : Differentiable ℝ (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) := by
    apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
    exact hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hdiv := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
    (show (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (E j) y) =
        (fun y => (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) from by
      funext y
      change (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) y = _
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_one, one_mul, mul_comm] using
        ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  conv at hdiv =>
    lhs
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt]
  conv at hdiv =>
    rhs
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul hρ.differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hdiv
  have hcurl (j) : ∂ₜ (B j) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (E i)) x - ∂[i] (∂[j] (E j)) x := by
    dsimp only [B, E]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
    · conv_lhs =>
        enter [2, y]
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out)]
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
          fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      congr 1
      rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs _), Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    · apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      exact hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have he : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) =
      (fun s => 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, B j s - 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * K s) := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hc : 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) = 𝓕.c ^ 2 := by
    simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, one_div, mul_inv_rev] <;> ring
  have hb : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ := by
    rw [← hc]
    simp [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [he, Time.deriv_eq,
      fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
        (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
      fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
      fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
      fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq]
    simp only [hcurl, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, hdiv, hc]
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_one_div, hb]

problems.author: 남성우
problems.proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  have h φs' φs :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι (𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
    let l1 :=
      List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel) ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
    let l2 :=
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)
    have hs χ ξ
        (hχ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ χ ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel χ φ)
        (hξ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ξ ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel ξ φ) :
        ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ χ :: ξ :: φs)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ χ :: ξ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [χ, ξ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
      rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
        show φs' ++ χ :: ξ :: φs = φs' ++ [χ, ξ] ++ φs by simp,
        crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [χ, ξ] φs (by simp_all)]
      simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not, Bool.decide_and,
        ofCrAnListF_append, map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
    trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
      (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
        ι (ofCrAnListF l2))
    · conv_lhs =>
        rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
          superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [ofList_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul,
          Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
          ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc,
          List.cons_append, List.nil_append, map_sub, map_smul]
        rw [hs φ ψ (by simp) ⟨hφψ, hψφ⟩,
          hs ψ φ ⟨hφψ, hψφ⟩ (by simp)]
      rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ,
        superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
      simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.singleton_append,
        map_sub, map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
        Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub]
      module
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
      mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
    simp only [l1, l2, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc] at h1 ⊢
    rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
        (by symm; simpa using hq), ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  conv_rhs => rw [map_mul]
  rw [← ofCrAnListFBasis.linearCombination_repr a,
    ← ofCrAnListFBasis.linearCombination_repr b]
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
    Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_sum, map_smul,
    ofListBasis_eq_ofList, h]

problems.name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
problems.author: 남성우
problems.proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  let k := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hself := (real_inner_self_pos (x := toL2 ℝ (f x₀))).mpr $
    mt (congrArg (fromL2 ℝ)) hx0
  have hc : Continuous k := Continuous.inner' _ _ hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc) x₀ hself
  letI := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδpos, half_lt_self hδpos⟩
  have hp := (φ.contDiff (n := 0)).continuous.mul hc
  have hn x : 0 ≤ φ x * k x := by
    by_cases hx : φ x = 0
    · simp only [hx, zero_mul, le_refl]
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hδ (φ.support_eq ▸ hx)).le
  apply ((integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg hn
    (hp.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right)).mpr $
    (isOpen_ne.preimage hp).measure_pos μ
      ⟨x₀, ne_of_gt $ mul_pos
        (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδpos)) hself⟩).ne'
  simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hg _ $
    IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ $
      contDiff_const (c := f x₀)

problems.author: 남성우
problems.proof:
lemma inv_convex {x y : HermitianMat d 𝕜} (hx : x.mat.PosDef) (hy : y.mat.PosDef)
    ⦃a b : ℝ⦄ (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b = 1) :
    (a • x + b • y)⁻¹ ≤ a • x⁻¹ + b • y⁻¹ := by
  have h_schur : (a • x.mat + b • y.mat).PosDef := by
    by_cases h : a = 0
    · rw [h, zero_add] at hab
      simpa [h, hab] using hy
    · exact (hx.smul (ha.lt_of_ne' h)).add_posSemidef $
        hy.posSemidef.smul hb
  let z := (a • x.mat + b • y.mat)⁻¹
  have hquad (A : Matrix d d 𝕜) (hA : A.PosDef) :
      (A⁻¹ - z - z + z * A * z).PosSemidef := by
    have hu := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne'
    convert hA.posSemidef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (A⁻¹ - z) using 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, hA.inv.posSemidef.1,
      h_schur.inv.posSemidef.1]
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hu, mul_one]
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hu, one_mul]
    abel
  have hsum : a • (z * x.mat * z) + b • (z * y.mat * z) = z := by
    simpa only [mul_add, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul] using
      congrArg (· * z) $ Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ $
        isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h_schur.det_pos.ne'
  change (a • x.mat⁻¹ + b • y.mat⁻¹ - z).PosSemidef
  convert ((hquad _ hx).smul ha).add ((hquad _ hy).smul hb) using 1
  simp only [smul_add, smul_sub]
  calc
    _ = a • x.mat⁻¹ + b • y.mat⁻¹ -
        (a • z + b • z) - (a • z + b • z) +
        (a • (z * x.mat * z) + b • (z * y.mat * z)) := by
      simp only [← add_smul, hab, one_smul, hsum, sub_add_cancel]
    _ = _ := by abel

problems.author: 남성우
problems.proof:
lemma cauchyBinet {m : ℕ} {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) n R) (B : Matrix n (Fin m) R) :
    (A * B).det = ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m},
      (A.submatrix id (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2)).det *
      (B.submatrix (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2) id).det := by
  have hd (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) :
      M.det = ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m), (∏ i, M i (τ i)) * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : R) := by
    rw [← Matrix.det_transpose M, Matrix.det_apply']
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_comm _ _
  have h_cauchy_binet : (A * B).det = ∑ σ : Fin m → n,
      (∏ i, A i (σ i)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j ↦ B (σ i) j)) := by
    simp only [hd, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    simp only [prod_sum, sum_mul]
    refine' Finset.sum_bij (fun f _ i => f i (Finset.mem_univ _)) _ _ _ _
    · exact fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _
    · simp only [univ_pi_univ, mem_univ, funext_iff, forall_true_left, forall_const]
      exact fun _ _ h => h
    · simp only [mem_univ, univ_pi_univ, exists_const, forall_const]
      exact fun b => ⟨fun i _ => b i, rfl⟩
    · simp only [univ_pi_univ, mem_univ, prod_mul_distrib, prod_attach_univ, forall_const]
      intro a
      ac_rfl
  let f := fun σ : Fin m → n => (∏ i, A i (σ i)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j ↦ B (σ i) j))
  rw [h_cauchy_binet]
  change (∑ σ, f σ) = _
  trans ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m}, ∑ σ,
    if Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val then f σ else 0
  · rw [← Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    by_cases hσ : Function.Injective σ
    · simp only [hσ, true_and]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨Finset.image σ Finset.univ, by
        simp only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hσ, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]⟩]
      · exact (if_pos rfl).symm
      · intro T _ hT
        exact if_neg (fun h => hT (Subtype.ext h.symm))
      · simp only [mem_univ, not_true_eq_false, false_implies]
    · simp only [hσ, false_and, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      simp only [Function.Injective, not_forall, not_imp] at hσ
      obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := hσ
      exact mul_eq_zero_of_right _ (Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq hne (by
        ext1
        simp only [of_apply, hij]))
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
    let e := S.val.orderEmbOfFin S.property
    have he : Finset.image e Finset.univ = S.val := by
      refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
        (Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr fun i _ => Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _) ?_
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.injective]
      simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, S.2, le_refl]
    have hf : Finset.filter (fun σ : Fin m → n => Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val) Finset.univ =
        Finset.image (fun τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m) => fun i => e (τ i)) Finset.univ := by
      ext σ
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
      constructor
      · intro hσ
        have h_exists_a : ∀ i, ∃ a : Fin m, σ i = e a := by
          intro i
          have hmem : σ i ∈ Finset.image e Finset.univ := by
            rw [he, ← hσ.2]
            exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
          obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
          exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩
        choose a ha using h_exists_a
        have ha_inj : Function.Injective a :=
          fun i j hij => hσ.1 <| by simp only [ha, hij]
        exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective a ⟨ha_inj, Finite.injective_iff_surjective.mp ha_inj⟩,
          funext fun i => (ha i).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        constructor
        · exact e.injective.comp a.injective
        · refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
            (Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr fun i _ => Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _) ?_
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (show Function.Injective (fun i => e (a i)) from e.injective.comp a.injective)]
          simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, S.2, le_refl]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hf, Finset.sum_image]
    · rw [hd (A.submatrix id e), Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ _ => ?_
      change (∏ i, A i (e (τ i))) * ((B.submatrix e id).submatrix τ id).det = _
      rw [Matrix.det_permute]
      ac_rfl
    · exact fun τ _ τ' _ h => Equiv.Perm.ext fun i => e.injective (congr_fun h i)

  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals replace der' := der'.wf
  case var | sub => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, t₁, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact ⟨t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂, by grind⟩
      · exact ⟨t₁.app t₂', by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.app t₂, by grind⟩
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, t, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨t ^ᵗᵞ σ', by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨.tapp t' σ', by grind⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    · exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, by grind⟩
  case inl der _ ih | inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · left
      constructor
      exact val
    · right
      exact ⟨_, by constructor; assumption⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨t₁, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      · exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, by grind⟩
      · exact ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, by grind⟩
    · exact ⟨t₁'.case t₂ t₃, by grind⟩
  case abs | tabs =>
    left
    constructor
    grind only []

  case' par ha' hb' iha ihb =>

    · cases I_irreducible _ ha'

    · rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ ha' with ⟨_, h, rfl⟩

      rcases ihb hb'' with ⟨b₃, hb⟩

    cases I_irreducible _ hc

  case red_K.par ha hc =>

theorem of_consensus [Fintype P] (f : ℕ) (hf : f < card P)
    (hc : a.Consensus f) : a.PseudoConsensus f := by
  use hc.1
  rintro inp s ⟨xl, h_xl⟩ ps h_ps
  revert hc
  let xls := a.fairSegActions (a.simpleDeliver ps) ps s
  let xs := xl ++ω xls.flatten
  rcases fair_omegaExecution (simpleDeliver_fair ps) s trivial with ⟨ss, h_omega, h_s, h_tailFair⟩
  rcases LTS.OmegaExecution.append h_xl h_omega h_s with ⟨ss', h_omega', h_start, h_prefix, h_suffix⟩
  have h_psfair : ∀ p ∈ ps, ProcFair p ss' xs := by
    clear hf h_ps h_xl
    intro p h_p
    rw [← Algorithm.drop_procFair_iff h_omega' p xl.length]
    grind [drop_append_of_ge_length]
  clear h_tailFair
  have h_dest := omega_forall_actions (r := _) (d := a.simpleDeliver ps)
      (simpleDeliver_fair ps) s trivial (simpleDeliver_forallActions ps) (by simp [DestIn])
  have h_fair : FairRun ss' xs := by
    clear hf h_ps h_xl h_s h_start h_prefix h_suffix h_omega
    intro p
    by_cases h_f : ProcFair p ss' xs
    · grind only
    · rcases Algorithm.not_fair_stay_enabled h_omega' h_f with ⟨m, _, n, _, _⟩
      suffices ProcFaulty p ss' xs by grind only
      use n + xl.length, by grind only
      intro k h_k m' h_m'
      simp only [xs, get_append_right', show xl.length ≤ k by omega] at h_m'
      grind only [DestIn]
  have h_bound : numProcFaulty ss' xs ≤ f := by
    suffices numProcFaulty ss' xs ≤ card P - ps.ncard by omega
    apply numProcFaulty_le_not_procFair
    assumption
  have h_adm : a.AdmissibleRun inp f ss' xs := by
    clear h_dest h_psfair h_prefix h_suffix h_omega
    grind only [Algorithm.AdmissibleRun]
  clear h_psfair h_fair h_xl h_ps h_start h_prefix
  rcases not_procFaulty_of_numProcFaulty (h_bound.trans_lt hf) with ⟨p, hp⟩
  intro hc
  obtain ⟨n, b, h_dec⟩ : ∃ n b, (ss' n).ProcDecided p b := by
    clear h_dest h_s h_suffix h_omega' h_omega
    grind only [ProcTermination, hc.2 inp ss' xs h_adm p]
  clear hc h_adm h_bound hp hf
  use ss n, b
  constructor
  · use xls.flatten.extract 0 n, by grind only [LTS.OmegaExecution.extract_mTr]
    simp [extract_eq_take, List.forall_iff_forall_mem, List.forall_mem_iff_getElem]
    grind
  · have : (ss' n).Decided b := by use p
    clear h_dest h_s h_dec h_omega
    suffices a.lts.CanReach (ss' n) (ss n) by grind only [Algorithm.decided_stable]
    use xs.extract n (n + xl.length)
    grind [LTS.OmegaExecution.extract_mTr]

    Saturates (fun i ↦ (na.buchiFamily i).toSet) (language na).toSet := by

  obtain ⟨xl, xls, h_xl_c, h_xls_c, rfl⟩ := mem_buchiFamily.mp h_xs
  obtain ⟨yl, yls, h_yl_c, h_yls_c, rfl⟩ := mem_buchiFamily.mp h_ys

  let f k := xl.length + xls.cumLen k

  have h_yl_e := LTS.Execution.to_mTr
    (buchiCongruence_transfer (s := ss 0) (t := ts 0) h_xl_c h_yl_c (by
      clear h_xl_c h_xls_c h_yl_c h_yls_c h_init h_acc
      grind [LTS.OmegaExecution.extract_mTr h_exec (Nat.zero_le xl.length),
        extract_append_zero_right, LTS.mem_pairLang])).choose_spec.1
  clear h_xl_c h_yl_c
  simp only [Language.mem_sub_one] at h_xls_c h_yls_c
  have h_xls_p k := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (h_xls_c k).2
  have h_yls_p k := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (h_yls_c k).2
  choose sls h_yls_e h_yls_a using fun k ↦
    buchiCongruence_transfer (s := ts k) (t := ts (k + 1))
      (h_xls_c k).left (h_yls_c k).left (by
        clear h_xls_c h_yls_c h_init h_acc h_yls_p h_yl_e
        grind [LTS.OmegaExecution.extract_mTr h_exec (?_ : f k ≤ f (k + 1)),
          LTS.mem_pairLang, extract_append_right_right, add_tsub_cancel_left])
  obtain ⟨ss1, h_ss1_run, h_ss1_seg⟩ := LTS.OmegaExecution.flatten_execution h_yls_e h_yls_p
  clear h_xls_c h_yls_c
  have h_start m : ss1 (yls.cumLen m) = ts m := by
    clear h_xls_p h_acc h_exec h_init h_yls_a h_ss1_run h_yl_e
    specialize h_yls_e m
    specialize h_ss1_seg m
    have h := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (cumLen_strictMono h_yls_p (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
    clear h_yls_p
    have : 0 < (sls m).length := by grind
    have := h_yls_e.choose_spec.1
    grind [get_extract (xs := ss1) h]
  suffices ∃ᶠ k in atTop, ss1 k ∈ na.accept by
    obtain ⟨ss2, h2⟩ := LTS.OmegaExecution.append h_yl_e h_ss1_run (by simpa using h_start 0)
    use ss2
    have := @drop_frequently_iff_frequently _ ss2 na.accept yl.length
    clear h_xls_p h_yls_p h_yls_e h_yls_a h_ss1_seg h_exec h_acc h_start
    grind [Run.mk]
  apply frequently_atTop.mpr
  intro n
  obtain ⟨m, _, s, _, h_mem⟩ :=
    frequently_atTop.mp ((frequently_via_accept h_acc h_exec h_xls_p f rfl ts rfl).mono h_yls_a) n
  obtain ⟨k, _, _⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp h_mem
  use yls.cumLen m + k
  suffices ss1 (yls.cumLen m + k) = (sls m)[k] by
    have := StrictMono.add_le_nat (cumLen_strictMono h_yls_p) m 0
    lia
  clear h_xls_p h_acc h_exec h_init h_yls_a h_ss1_run h_yl_e
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _⟩ := h_yls_e m
  by_cases hk : k < (yls m).length
  · specialize h_ss1_seg m
    clear h_yls_p h_yls_e h_start
    have h : k < yls.cumLen (m + 1) - yls.cumLen m := by
      clear h_ss1_seg

    clear h_start h_yls_p h_yls_e h_ss1_seg

theorem subset_inp [Fintype P] {ps : Set P} {inp1 inp2 : P → Bool} {s1 : State P M S}
    (he : InpEqOn ps inp1 inp2) (hr : a.CanReachVia ps (a.start inp1) s1) :
    ∃ s2, a.CanReachVia ps (a.start inp2) s2 ∧ s2.proc = s1.proc := by
  suffices sim : ∀ {s u xs}, a.lts.MTr s xs u →
      ∀ t, State.proc t = s.proc →
      (∀ m, m.dest ∈ ps → t.msgs.count m = s.msgs.count m) →
      xs.Forall (DestIn ps) →
      ∃ v, a.CanReachVia ps t v ∧ v.proc = u.proc by
    obtain ⟨xs, h, hx⟩ := hr
    refine sim h _ rfl ?_ hx
    intro m hm
    simp only [Algorithm.start, count_map, Message.ext_iff]
    congr
    grind only [InpEqOn]
  intro s u xs h
  induction h <;> intro t hp hm hx
  next =>
    exact ⟨t, refl ps t, hp⟩
  next s x u xs v ht h ih =>
    rw [List.forall_cons] at hx
    obtain ⟨hx, hxs⟩ := hx
    cases x with
    | none =>
      cases ht
      exact ih t hp hm hxs
    | some m =>
      obtain ⟨hmem, rfl⟩ := ht
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwp⟩ := ih (a.recvMsg m t)
        (by simp only [Algorithm.recvMsg, hp])
        (by
          intro n hn
          rcases eq_or_ne n m with rfl | hnm <;>
            simp [Algorithm.recvMsg, count_erase_of_ne, *]) hxs

problems.author: 남성우
problems.proof:
theorem parallel_diamond : Diamond ((· ⭢ₚ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) := by
  have join {m l r : Term Var} {xs ys : Finset Var}
      (ih : ∀ x ∉ xs, ∀ {v}, (m ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ v →
        ∃ w, (l ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ w ∧ v ⭢ₚ w)
      (hr : ∀ x ∉ ys, (m ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ r ^ fvar x) :
      ∃ w, abs l ⭢ₚ w ∧ abs r ⭢ₚ w := by
    have ⟨x, qx⟩ := fresh_exists $ xs ∪ ys ∪ fv l ∪ fv r
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at qx
    have ⟨w, hw⟩ := ih x qx.1.1.1 (hr x qx.1.1.2)
    suffices ∀ {v}, x ∉ fv v → (v ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ w →
        abs v ⭢ₚ abs (w ^* x) from
      ⟨_, this qx.1.2 hw.1, this qx.2 hw.2⟩
    clear ih hr hw qx
    intro v hv h
    apply Parallel.abs ∅
    intro y _
    have := para_open_close x y 0 h
    grind
  intros t t1 t2 tpt1
  induction tpt1 generalizing t2 <;> intro tpt2
  case fvar x =>
    cases tpt2
    exact ⟨_, Parallel.fvar x, Parallel.fvar x⟩
  case abs =>
    rename_i ih
    cases tpt2
    rename_i mem'
    exact join ih mem'
  case beta =>
    rename_i ih1 ih2
    cases tpt2
    case' app =>
      rename_i s1pu2 s2pu2'
      cases s1pu2
      rename_i mem'
    case' beta =>
      rename_i mem' s2pu2'
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨w, hl, hr⟩ := join ih1 mem'
      obtain ⟨v, hv1, hv2⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
      cases hl
      cases hr
      rename_i ys hys zs hzs
      exact ⟨_, para_open_out ys hys hv1, by
        first
        | exact Parallel.beta zs hzs hv2
        | exact para_open_out zs hzs hv2⟩
  case app =>
    rename_i s1ps1' _ ih1 ih2
    cases tpt2
    case app =>
      rename_i s1 s2
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := ih1 s1
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := ih2 s2
      exact ⟨_, Parallel.app hl hr, Parallel.app hl' hr'⟩
    case beta =>
      rename_i xs mem s2pu2'
      cases s1ps1'
      obtain ⟨t', qt'_l, qt'_r⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
      obtain ⟨t'', qt''_l, qt''_r⟩ := ih1 (Parallel.abs xs mem)
      cases qt''_l
      cases qt''_r
      rename_i xs'' mem'' xs''' mem'''
      exact ⟨_, Parallel.beta xs'' mem'' qt'_l,
        para_open_out xs''' mem''' qt'_r⟩

theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :

      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by

    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero =>

        have h_u_eq: u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx

        unfold jointProximityNat

        let P : F → (Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1) → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init =>

        let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
          (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (F := F) (P := P)
        unfold P at hP_split_r_last
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last

        let  ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1

            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by

          rfl
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]

          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          let res := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (u := u)
            (e := e) (hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt)
          exact res
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        apply h_interleaved_gaps (2^(ϑ_sub_2+1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
        apply lt_of_lt_of_le h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
        apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
        intro r hr
        exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC) (ih := ih (by omega)) (u := u) ⟨r,hr⟩

problems.author: 손지연
problems.proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := (fiberMap k)) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have h_eval_qMap_x₀ := h_eval 0
  have h_eval_qMap_x₁ := h_eval 1
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h0 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i (by omega) y 0
    have h1 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i (by omega) y 1
    have hv0 := congrArg Subtype.val h0
    have hv1 := congrArg Subtype.val h1
    dsimp only [x₀, x₁, fiberMap]
    rw [hv1, hv0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  have h_equation_39_x₀ : P_i.eval x₀.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [x₀, x₁, h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₀, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_equation_39_x₁ : P_i.eval x₁.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [x₀, x₁, h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      h_eval_qMap_x₁, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_fold_def : f_i_plus_1 y =
      f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
      f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := h_fold_def
    _ = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by simp only [f_i]
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      rw [h_equation_39_x₀, h_equation_39_x₁]
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      linear_combination (P₀.eval y.val * (1-r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) * h_fiber_diff
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      rw [←Polynomial.eval_add]
      congr
      simp_rw [mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have h_j_lt : j.val < 2 ^ (ℓ - (↑i + 1)) := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq]
        omega
      simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
      ring

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    omega
  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := ⟨0⟩
  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    obtain ⟨g, _, heq⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem
      (show S.Nonempty from Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
    exact ⟨g.val, g.property, heq.symm⟩
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    change ΔH.card ≤ _
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    letI : Fintype Y_bad := Fintype.ofFinite Y_bad
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x),
        (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega) (x := x) (y := y)).mp rfl⟩
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ Y_bad.toFinset.card * 2 ^ steps := by
        apply Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul
        intro y hy
        simpa only [Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range,
          Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
          (Finset.card_image_le (s := Finset.univ)
            (f := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
              (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)))
      _ = _ := by simp only [Set.toFinset_card, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    exact (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' h_g'_mem).trans h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have hnat : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) < d_i := by
    apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_d_i_gt_0
    rw [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, ← h_algebraic_identity, ← mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound
  change (2 : ℕ∞) * d_H < (d_i : ℕ∞)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' h_dist_bridge 2).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hnat)

lemma master_lemma
  [Nonempty ι]
  {φ : ι ↪ F} {dstar m : ℕ}
  {fs : Fin m → ι → F} {degs : Fin m → ℕ} (hdegs : ∀ i, degs i ≤ dstar)
  {δ : ℝ≥0}
  (hδLt : δ < (min (1 - (ReedSolomon.sqrtRate dstar φ))
    (1 - (rate (code φ dstar)) - 1 / Fintype.card ι)))
  {S : Finset ι}
  (hS_card : (1 - δ) * (Fintype.card ι) ≤ S.card)
  {v : (i : Fin m) → Fin (block_size dstar degs i) → Polynomial F}
  (hv_deg : ∀ i j, (v i j).degree < dstar)
  (hv_eval : ∀ i j, ∀ x ∈ S, (v i j).eval (φ x) = (φ x) ^ j.val * (fs i x))
  (i : Fin m)
  (j : Fin (block_size dstar degs i)) :
  (v i j).degree < degs i + j := by
  have hlt : dstar < Fintype.card ι := by
    by_contra contra
    have hh := lt_of_lt_of_le hδLt (min_le_right _ _)
    rw [ReedSolomon.rateOfLinearCode_eq_min_div, min_eq_right (Nat.le_of_not_gt contra)] at hh
    simp [Fintype.card_ne_zero] at hh
  rcases j with ⟨j, hj⟩
  simp only [block_size] at hj
  generalize hj': (dstar - degs i) - j = j'
  revert j
  induction j' with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj hj'
    have hd := hdegs i
    have he : degs i + j = dstar := by omega
    change (v i ⟨j,hj⟩).degree < ((degs i+j : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
    rw [he]
    exact hv_deg i ⟨j,hj⟩
  | succ j' ih =>
    intro j hj hj'
    have h_fin : j + 1 < dstar - degs i + 1 := by omega
    specialize ih (j + 1) h_fin (by omega)
    let q : Polynomial F := Polynomial.X * v i ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hq_deg : q.degree < dstar + 1 := by
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X, add_comm]
      exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_right (by simp)).mpr (hv_deg i ⟨j, hj⟩)
    have hq_coincide :
      ∀ x ∈ S, q.eval (φ x) = (v i ⟨j + 1, h_fin⟩).eval (φ x) := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [q, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hv_eval i _ x hx, pow_succ]
      ring
    have hq_coincide :=
      Polynomial.eq_of_eval_eq_degree
        (q := v i ⟨j + 1, h_fin⟩)
        hq_deg (lt_trans (hv_deg _ _) (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self dstar))) (Finset.image φ S) (by {
          simp only [Nat.cast_id, ge_iff_le, Order.add_one_le_iff]
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ φ.injective]
          have h : ↑(rate (code φ dstar)) + 1 / ↑(Fintype.card ι) < 1 - δ :=
            glorious_lemma
              (by simpa using hδLt)
              rfl
          have h :=
            le_trans
              (le_of_lt <|
                even_more_glorious_lemma (m := Fintype.card ι)
                  (by simp) (by {
                    rw [ReedSolomon.rateOfLinearCode_eq_min_div,
                        min_eq_left hlt.le] at h
                    simpa using h
                  }))
              hS_card
          norm_cast at h
        })
        (by
          intro x hx
          obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
          exact hq_coincide y hy)
    simp only [q] at hq_coincide
    rw [←hq_coincide] at ih
    simp only [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X, WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_one] at ih
    rw [←add_assoc, add_comm 1] at ih
    exact (WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_right (by simp)).mp ih

problems.name: JohnsonBound.johnson_bound_alphabet_free
problems.author: 손지연
problems.proof:
theorem johnson_bound_alphabet_free [Field F]
    {B : Finset (Fin n → F)} {v : Fin n → F} {e : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B.card) :
    let d := sInf { d | ∃ u ∈ B, ∃ v ∈ B, u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
    let q : ℚ := card F
    let _frac := q / (q - 1)
    e ≤ n - ((n * (n - d)) : ℝ).sqrt →
    (B ∩ ({ x | Δ₀(x, v) ≤ e } : Finset _)).card ≤ q * d * n := by
  intro d q frac h
  let B' := B ∩ ({ x | Δ₀(x, v) ≤ e } : Finset _)
  have q_not_small : q ≥ (2 : ℚ) := by
    change (2 : ℚ) ≤ (card F : ℚ)
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.2 (Fintype.one_lt_card : 1 < card F))
  have d_not_small : d ≥ 1 := by
    let S : Set ℕ := { d | ∃ u ∈ B, ∃ v ∈ B, u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
    simpa [S] using sInf.le_sInf_of_LB (S := S) (i := 1)
      (by obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := one_lt_card.mp hB
          exact ⟨hammingDist u v, u, hu, v, hv, huv, rfl⟩)
      (fun s ⟨u, _, v, _, huv, hdist⟩ => hdist ▸ Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hammingDist_pos.mpr huv))
  have d_le_n : d ≤ n := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := one_lt_card.mp hB
    exact le_trans (Nat.sInf_le ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw, rfl⟩)
      (by simpa using hammingDist_le_card_fintype (x := u) (y := w))
  have n_not_small : n ≥ 1 := d_not_small.trans d_le_n
  have qdn_not_small : (q * d * n) ≥ 2 := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using johnson_qdn_ge_two q_not_small d_not_small n_not_small
  by_cases h_size : B'.card < 2
  · exact le_trans (show (B'.card : ℚ) ≤ 1 from by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ h_size)
      (le_trans (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 2) qdn_not_small)
  · have hd_le_dB' : (d : ℚ) ≤ JohnsonBound.d B' := by
      let S : Set ℕ := { d | ∃ u ∈ B, ∃ v ∈ B, u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
      let S' : Set ℕ := { d | ∃ u ∈ B', ∃ v ∈ B', u ≠ v ∧ hammingDist u v = d }
      have hsubset : S' ⊆ S := fun _ ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw, hd⟩ =>
        ⟨u, (mem_inter.mp hu).1, w, (mem_inter.mp hw).1, huw, hd⟩
      have hS'nonempty : S'.Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, huw⟩ := one_lt_card.mp (show 1 < B'.card by omega)
        exact ⟨hammingDist u w, u, hu, w, hw, huw, rfl⟩
      calc (d : ℚ)
          ≤ ↑(sInf S') := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sInf_le (hsubset (Nat.sInf_mem hS'nonempty))
        _ ≤ JohnsonBound.d B' := by exact_mod_cast min_dist_le_d (B := B') (by omega)
    have hn_pos_nat : 0 < n := Nat.succ_le_iff.1 n_not_small
    have hn_pos : (0 : ℚ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos_nat
    have hq1_pos : (0 : ℚ) < q - 1 := by linarith
    by_cases h_d_close_n : q / (q - 1) * (d / n) > 1
    · have h_strong : JohnsonConditionStrong B' v := by
        simpa [JohnsonConditionStrong, q, mul_div_assoc] using
          lt_of_lt_of_le (show (1 - (q / (q - 1)) * (JohnsonBound.d B' / n) : ℚ) < 0 from by
            linarith [lt_of_lt_of_le h_d_close_n (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd_le_dB' (by exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_nonneg n))
              (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)))]) (sq_nonneg _)
      have hden_ge : JohnsonDenominator B' v ≥ frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 1 := by
        simpa [JohnsonDenominator, q, frac, mul_div_assoc] using
          johnson_den_ge_frac_d (B := B') (v := v)
      have hgap : frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / (n : ℚ) - 1 ≥ 1 / (n * (q - 1)) := by
        simpa [q, frac] using johnson_gap_frac_d_gt_one (B := B')
          (q_not_small := by simpa [q] using q_not_small)
          (n_not_small := n_not_small)
          (h_d_close_n := by simpa [q, frac] using h_d_close_n)
          (hd_le_dB := hd_le_dB')
      have hden_lb : (1 : ℚ) / (n * (q - 1)) ≤ JohnsonDenominator B' v := by linarith
      have hnum_nonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n :=
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
          (le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le d) hd_le_dB')) hn_pos.le
      calc (B'.card : ℚ)
          ≤ (frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n) / JohnsonDenominator B' v := by
            simpa using johnson_bound h_strong
        _ ≤ (frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n) / (1 / (n * (q - 1))) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum_nonneg
              (one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos hn_pos hq1_pos)) hden_lb
        _ = q * JohnsonBound.d B' := by
            dsimp [frac]
            field_simp
            <;> ring
        _ ≤ q * d * n := by
            have hd_le_n := johnson_d_le_n (B := B') (le_of_not_gt h_size)
            have hd_ge1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (d : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast d_not_small
            have hq_nn : (0 : ℚ) ≤ q := by linarith
            nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le_n hq_nn,
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_ge1 (mul_nonneg hq_nn (le_of_lt hn_pos))]
    · have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ n := hn_pos.le
      have hq_pos : (0 : ℚ) < q := by linarith
      have hfrac_pos : (0 : ℚ) < frac := div_pos hq_pos hq1_pos
      have hfrac_gt1 : (1 : ℚ) < frac := by
        simpa [frac] using (one_lt_div hq1_pos).2 (by linarith : q - 1 < q)
      have hn2_pos : (0 : ℚ) < (n : ℚ) ^ 2 := pow_pos hn_pos _
      have h_div'_q : (1 - (d / n : ℚ)) ≤ (1 - (e / n : ℚ)) ^ 2 := by
        have hr : ((1 - (d / n : ℚ)) : ℝ) ≤ ((1 - (e / n : ℚ)) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          simpa using johnson_hyp_implies_div_ineq hn_pos_nat d_le_n h
        exact_mod_cast hr
      have denom_expansion : JohnsonDenominator B' v =
          frac * (JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
          frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [JohnsonDenominator, q, frac]
        ring
      have e_ineq : JohnsonBound.e B' v ≤ e := by
        simpa [B'] using JohnsonBound.e_ball_le_radius (B := B) (v := v) (r := (e : ℚ))
          (by simpa [B'] using show 0 < B'.card by omega)
      have hden1_pos : (0 : ℚ) <
          JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
            frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2 := by
        have he1 : (e : ℚ) / n ≤ 1 := by
          apply (div_le_one hn_pos).2
          exact_mod_cast h.trans (sub_le_self _ (sqrt_nonneg _))
        have heB := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right e_ineq hn_pos.le
        have hdB := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hd_le_dB' hn_pos.le
        have hquad : (0 : ℚ) ≤ JohnsonBound.d B' / n -
            2 * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) + (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith only [h_div'_q, hdB, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr heB)
            (show (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2 - (e : ℚ) / n - JohnsonBound.e B' v / n by linarith)]
        by_cases hz : JohnsonBound.e B' v / n = 0
        · simpa only [mul_div_assoc, hz, mul_zero, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), sub_zero,
            add_zero] using lt_of_lt_of_le
              (div_pos (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 d_not_small)) hn_pos) hdB
        · have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hfrac_gt1) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hz)
          simp only [mul_div_assoc]
          nlinarith only [hquad, hp]
      have h_johnson_strong : JohnsonConditionStrong B' v :=
        johnson_condition_strong_iff_johnson_denom_pos.2
          (by rw [denom_expansion]; exact mul_pos hfrac_pos hden1_pos)
      calc (B'.card : ℚ)
          ≤ (frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / n) / JohnsonDenominator B' v := by
            simpa using johnson_bound h_johnson_strong
        _ ≤ q * (d : ℚ) * n := by
            set D0 : ℚ := d / n
            set E0 : ℚ := e / n
            set Den : ℚ := D0 - 2 * E0 + frac * E0 ^ 2
            have quad_nonneg : (0 : ℚ) ≤ D0 - 2 * E0 + E0 ^ 2 := by
              change (0 : ℚ) ≤ d / n - 2 * (e / n) + (e / n) ^ 2
              nlinarith only [h_div'_q]
            have frac_sub_one_eq : frac - 1 = (1 : ℚ) / (q - 1) := by
              dsimp [frac]
              field_simp [hq1_pos.ne']
              <;> ring
            have one_div_q_le : (1 : ℚ) / q ≤ frac - 1 := by
              simpa [frac_sub_one_eq] using
                (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hq1_pos (by linarith : q - 1 ≤ q))
            have term_simplification : (frac * JohnsonBound.d B' / (n : ℚ)) /
                JohnsonDenominator B' v =
                (JohnsonBound.d B' / n) /
                (JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
                frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2) := by
                  rw [denom_expansion, mul_div_assoc]
                  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ hfrac_pos.ne'
            have worst_case_bound :
                (JohnsonBound.d B' / n) /
                (JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
                  frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2) ≤
                (d / n) / (d / n - 2 * e / n + frac * (e / n) ^ 2) :=
              johnson_worst_case_bound hn_pos (Nat.succ_le_iff.1 d_not_small) d_le_n h
                (le_of_not_gt h_d_close_n) hfrac_gt1 e_ineq hd_le_dB' quad_nonneg hden1_pos
            have hden_lb : (1 : ℚ) / (q * (n : ℚ) ^ 2) ≤ Den := by
              by_cases he0 : e = 0
              · subst he0; simpa [D0, E0, Den] using
                  johnson_den_lb_e_zero hn_pos_nat (by linarith) (by exact_mod_cast d_not_small)
              · exact johnson_den_lb_e_pos hn_pos he0 one_div_q_le
                  (by linarith) quad_nonneg
            rw [term_simplification]
            calc (JohnsonBound.d B' / n) /
                    (JohnsonBound.d B' / n - 2 * JohnsonBound.e B' v / n +
                      frac * (JohnsonBound.e B' v / n) ^ 2)
                ≤ (d / n) / (d / n - 2 * e / n + frac * (e / n) ^ 2) := worst_case_bound
              _ = (d / n) / Den := by simp [Den, D0, E0, mul_div_assoc]
              _ ≤ (d / n) / ((1 : ℚ) / (q * (n : ℚ) ^ 2)) :=
                  div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
                    (div_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le d) hn_nonneg)
                    (one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos hq_pos hn2_pos)) hden_lb
              _ = q * d * n := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hq_pos, ne_of_gt hn_pos]

problems.name: ProximityToRS.dir_close_of_many_close_pts
problems.author: 손지연
problems.proof:
lemma dir_close_of_many_close_pts
    {deg : ℕ}
    {α : ι ↪ F} {e : ℕ} {u v : ι → F}
    (he : (e : ℚ≥0) < ‖(RScodeSet α deg)‖₀ / 3)
    (h_many : numberOfClosePts u v deg α e > ‖(RScodeSet α deg)‖₀) :
    Δ₀(v, ReedSolomon.code α deg) ≤ e := by
  classical
  set CRS : Submodule F (ι → F) := ReedSolomon.code α deg
  set C : Set (ι → F) := (CRS : Set (ι → F))
  have h3e_lt : 3 * e < ‖C‖₀ := by
    have hq := (lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ≥0) < 3)).mp he
    have hq' : (3 : ℚ≥0) * (e : ℚ≥0) < (‖C‖₀ : ℚ≥0) := by
      simpa [C, CRS, RScodeSet, mul_comm] using hq
    exact_mod_cast hq'
  let P : F → Prop := fun r ↦ Δ₀(u + r • v, C) ≤ e
  let R : Finset F := Finset.filter P Finset.univ
  have h_close_le_card : numberOfClosePts u v deg α e ≤ R.card := by
    let f : {r : F // P r} → closePtsOnAffineLine (F := F) (u := u) (v := v)
        (deg := deg) (α := α) (e := e) :=
      fun r ↦
        ⟨u + r.1 • v,
          by
            refine ⟨?_, r.2⟩
            refine
              (Affine.mem_affineLineAtOrigin_iff (F := F) (origin := u) (direction := v) _).2 ?_
            exact ⟨r.1, rfl⟩⟩
    have hf_surj : Function.Surjective f := by
      rintro ⟨x, hx, hclose⟩
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ :=
        (Affine.mem_affineLineAtOrigin_iff (F := F) (origin := u) (direction := v) x).1 hx
      exact ⟨⟨r, hclose⟩, rfl⟩
    simpa [numberOfClosePts, Fintype.card_subtype, R, P] using
      Fintype.card_le_of_surjective f hf_surj
  have hR_gt : R.card > ‖C‖₀ := by
    have h_many' : numberOfClosePts u v deg α e > ‖C‖₀ := by
      simpa [C, CRS, RScodeSet] using h_many
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_many' h_close_le_card
  let RS : Type := {r : F // r ∈ R}
  have hRS_card : Fintype.card RS = R.card := by
    classical
    simp [RS]
  have hRS_gt : Fintype.card RS > ‖C‖₀ := by simpa [hRS_card] using hR_gt
  have hRS_one_lt : 1 < Fintype.card RS := by omega
  obtain ⟨r0, r1, hr01⟩ := Fintype.one_lt_card_iff.mp hRS_one_lt
  have hP_of_mem (r : RS) : P r.1 := by
    have : r.1 ∈ R := r.2
    simpa [R, P, C] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp this).2
  have h_close_codeword (r : RS) : ∃ c ∈ C, Δ₀(u + r.1 • v, c) ≤ e :=
    (Code.closeToCode_iff_closeToCodeword_of_minDist (u := u + r.1 • v) (C := C) (e := e)).1
      (hP_of_mem r)
  choose c hc_mem hc_dist using h_close_codeword
  have h_disagree (r : RS) :
      ∃ D : Finset ι, D.card ≤ e ∧ ∀ j, j ∉ D → (u + r.1 • v) j = c r j :=
    (Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_possibleDisagreeCols (u := u + r.1 • v) (v := c r) (e := e)).1
      (hc_dist r)
  choose E hE_card hE_agree using h_disagree
  have hr10 : (r1.1 - r0.1) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by
    intro h
    apply hr01
    ext
    exact h.symm)
  let w : ι → F := (r1.1 - r0.1)⁻¹ • (c r1 - c r0)
  have hw_mem : w ∈ CRS := by
    exact CRS.smul_mem _ (CRS.sub_mem (hc_mem r1) (hc_mem r0))
  have hv_eq_w_of_notin (j : ι) (hj0 : j ∉ E r0) (hj1 : j ∉ E r1) : v j = w j := by
    have h1 := hE_agree r1 j hj1
    have h0 := hE_agree r0 j hj0
    change u j + r1.1 * v j = c r1 j at h1
    change u j + r0.1 * v j = c r0 j at h0
    change v j = (r1.1 - r0.1)⁻¹ * (c r1 j - c r0 j)
    rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hr10]
    linear_combination h1 - h0
  let cBase : ι → F := c r0 - r0.1 • w
  have h_codeword_eq (r : RS) : c r = cBase + r.1 • w := by
    by_cases hr0 : r = r0
    · subst hr0
      simp [cBase]
    · have hneq : (r.1 - r0.1) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by
        intro h
        apply hr0
        ext
        exact h)
      let w0r : ι → F := (r.1 - r0.1)⁻¹ • (c r - c r0)
      have hw0r_mem : w0r ∈ CRS := by
        exact CRS.smul_mem _ (CRS.sub_mem (hc_mem r) (hc_mem r0))
      have hw0r_eq : w0r = w := by
        apply Code.eq_of_lt_dist (C := C)
        · exact hw0r_mem
        · exact hw_mem
        · have hdist : Δ₀(w0r, w) ≤ (E r0 ∪ E r1 ∪ E r).card := by
            refine hamming_dist_le_of_subset_disagree (ι := ι) (u := w0r) (v := w)
              (D := E r0 ∪ E r1 ∪ E r) ?_
            intro i hi
            by_contra hiU
            simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hiU
            rcases hiU with ⟨⟨hi0, hi1⟩, hir⟩
            have hvw : v i = w i := hv_eq_w_of_notin (j := i) hi0 hi1
            have hv0r : v i = w0r i := by
              have h1 := hE_agree r i hir
              have h0 := hE_agree r0 i hi0
              change u i + r.1 * v i = c r i at h1
              change u i + r0.1 * v i = c r0 i at h0
              change v i = (r.1 - r0.1)⁻¹ * (c r i - c r0 i)
              rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hneq]
              linear_combination h1 - h0
            exact hi (hv0r.symm.trans hvw)
          have hcard_le : (E r0 ∪ E r1 ∪ E r).card ≤ 3 * e := by
            have h01 := Finset.card_union_le (E r0) (E r1)
            have hu := Finset.card_union_le (E r0 ∪ E r1) (E r)
            have h0 := hE_card r0
            have h1 := hE_card r1
            have hr := hE_card r
            omega
          have : Δ₀(w0r, w) ≤ 3 * e := le_trans hdist hcard_le
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt this h3e_lt
      have hdiff : c r - c r0 = (r.1 - r0.1) • w := by
        have hsmul : (r.1 - r0.1) • w0r = (r.1 - r0.1) • w := by simp [hw0r_eq]
        simpa [w0r, smul_smul, hneq] using hsmul
      ext i
      have hh := congrArg (fun f => f i) hdiff
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hh
      change c r i = c r0 i - r0.1 * w i + r.1 * w i
      linear_combination hh
  have h_line_eq (r : RS) (j : ι) (hj : j ∉ E r) :
      (u + r.1 • v) j = (cBase + r.1 • w) j := by
    simpa only [h_codeword_eq r] using hE_agree r j hj
  let D : Finset ι := Finset.filter (fun j ↦ u j ≠ cBase j ∨ v j ≠ w j) Finset.univ
  have hD_card : D.card ≤ e := by
    have h_err_ge (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ D) :
        (Finset.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r) Finset.univ).card ≥ Fintype.card RS - 1 := by
      have hclean_le1 : (Finset.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∉ E r) Finset.univ).card ≤ 1 := by
        by_contra hgt
        have hone :
            1 < (Finset.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∉ E r) Finset.univ).card :=
          lt_of_not_ge hgt
        rcases Finset.one_lt_card.mp hone with ⟨r, hr, s, hs, hrs⟩
        have hr' : j ∉ E r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
        have hs' : j ∉ E s := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
        have hr_eq := h_line_eq r j hr'
        have hs_eq := h_line_eq s j hs'
        have hrs_val : r.1 ≠ s.1 := by
          intro h
          apply hrs
          ext
          exact h
        have hvw : v j = w j := by
          have hz : (r.1 - s.1) * (v j - w j) = 0 := by
            change u j + r.1 * v j = cBase j + r.1 * w j at hr_eq
            change u j + s.1 * v j = cBase j + s.1 * w j at hs_eq
            linear_combination hr_eq - hs_eq
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hrs_val))
        have hu_eq : u j = cBase j := by
          have hrj : u j + r.1 * v j = cBase j + r.1 * w j := by
            simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using hr_eq
          have : u j + r.1 * v j = cBase j + r.1 * v j := by simpa [hvw] using hrj
          exact add_right_cancel this
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.elim (fun h => h hu_eq) (fun h => h hvw)
      have hp := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset RS)) (p := fun r : RS => j ∈ E r)
      simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hp
      omega
    have h_pairs_le :
        (∑ j ∈ D, (Finset.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r) Finset.univ).card) ≤
          Fintype.card RS * e := by
      have h_pairs_le' :
          (∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι),
                (Finset.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r) Finset.univ).card) ≤
            Fintype.card RS * e := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ r : RS, (E r).card := by
            simp only [Finset.card_filter]
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            simp
          _ ≤ ∑ r : RS, e := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => hE_card r)
          _ = _ := by simp
      exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ D)).trans h_pairs_le'
    have h_pairs_ge :
        (∑ j ∈ D, (Finset.filter (fun r : RS ↦ j ∈ E r) Finset.univ).card) ≥
          D.card * (Fintype.card RS - 1) := by
      simpa [Finset.sum_const_nat, Nat.mul_comm] using Finset.sum_le_sum h_err_ge
    by_contra hD_gt
    have hd : e + 1 ≤ D.card := by omega
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Fintype.card RS - 1) hd
    have ht := h_pairs_ge.trans h_pairs_le
    have he' : e < Fintype.card RS - 1 := by omega
    have hc : Fintype.card RS = (Fintype.card RS - 1) + 1 := by omega
    nlinarith only [hp, ht, he', hc]
  have hdist_vw : Δ₀(v, w) ≤ D.card := by
    refine hamming_dist_le_of_subset_disagree (ι := ι) (u := v) (v := w) (D := D) ?_
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, Or.inr hj⟩
  have hmem := hw_mem
  have : Δ₀(v, CRS) ≤ e := le_trans
      (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem (C := (CRS : Set (ι → F))) (u := v) (v := w)
        (by simpa [C] using hmem))
      (by
        exact_mod_cast le_trans hdist_vw hD_card)
  simpa [CRS] using this

problems.author: 손지연
problems.proof:
theorem RS_exists_nonzero_kernelVec_of_det_eq_zero_natDegree_le_one (e : ℕ)
    (K : Matrix (Fin (e + 1)) (Fin (e + 1)) F[X])
    (hdeg : ∀ i j, (K i j).natDegree ≤ 1)
    (hdet : Matrix.det K = 0) :
    ∃ a : Fin (e + 1) → F[X],
      a ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ t, (a t).natDegree ≤ e) ∧ Matrix.mulVec K a = 0 := by
  classical
  let n := e + 1
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun r =>
    ∃ (I J : Fin r ↪ Fin n), Matrix.det (K.submatrix I J) ≠ 0
  have hP0 : P 0 := by
    refine ⟨Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty, Function.Embedding.ofIsEmpty, ?_⟩
    simp
  let r : ℕ := Nat.findGreatest P n
  have hPr : P r := Nat.findGreatest_spec (Nat.zero_le n) hP0
  rcases hPr with ⟨I,J,hIJ⟩
  have hPn : ¬ P n := by
    rintro ⟨I0, J0, hdet0⟩
    exact hdet0 (RS_det_submatrix_eq_zero_of_det_eq_zero n K hdet I0 J0)
  have hr_lt : r < n :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.findGreatest_le n) (fun h => hPn (h ▸ (show P r from ⟨I, J, hIJ⟩)))
  have hr_le_e : r ≤ e := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hr_lt
  have hnotP_succ : ¬ P (r + 1) :=
    Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (Nat.lt_succ_self r) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hr_lt)
  have missing (E : Fin r ↪ Fin n) : ∃ i, i ∉ Set.range E := by
    have hn : ¬ Function.Surjective E := by
      intro h
      have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_surjective E h
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hc
      omega
    simpa only [Function.Surjective, Set.mem_range, not_forall] using hn
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := missing I
  obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := missing J
  let I' := Fin.Embedding.snoc I hi0
  let J' := Fin.Embedding.snoc J hj0
  let B := K.submatrix I' J'
  have hdetB : Matrix.det B = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hnotP_succ ⟨I', J', h⟩
  let u := fun t => B.adjugate t (Fin.last r)
  have hBu : Matrix.mulVec B u = 0 :=
    RS_mulVec_adjugate_col_eq_zero_of_det_eq_zero (n := r + 1) (A := B) (j := Fin.last r) hdetB
  have hu_last : u (Fin.last r) ≠ 0 := by
    have hBsub : B.submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc = K.submatrix I J := by
      ext i j : 2
      simp [B, I', J']
    change B.adjugate (Fin.last r) (Fin.last r) ≠ 0
    rw [RS_adjugate_last_last_eq_det_submatrix_castSucc_castSucc, hBsub]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by simp) hIJ
  let a := Function.extend J' u (fun _ => 0)
  have ha_on : ∀ t : Fin (r + 1), a (J' t) = u t :=
    J'.injective.extend_apply u (fun _ => 0)
  have hmulVec_eq (i : Fin n) :
      (Matrix.mulVec K a) i = ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), K i (J' j) * u j := by
    symm
    apply Fintype.sum_of_injective (e := J') J'.injective
    · intro j hj
      have hz : a j = 0 := Function.extend_apply' u (fun _ => 0) j hj
      simp [hz]
    · intro t
      rw [ha_on t]
  refine ⟨a,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply hu_last
    simpa [h] using (ha_on (Fin.last r)).symm
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : ∃ s : Fin (r + 1), (J' s : Fin n) = t
    · rcases ht with ⟨s, rfl⟩
      rw [ha_on s]
      change (B.adjugate s (Fin.last r)).natDegree ≤ e
      rw [RS_adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix_last_castSucc]
      apply Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans
      simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_pow, Polynomial.natDegree_neg,
        Polynomial.natDegree_one, mul_zero, zero_add] using
        (RS_natDegree_det_le_of_entry_natDegree_le_one r
          (B.submatrix Fin.castSucc s.succAbove) (fun i j => hdeg _ _)).trans hr_le_e
    · have hz : a t = 0 := Function.extend_apply' u (fun _ => 0) t ht
      simp [hz]
  · funext i
    rw [hmulVec_eq]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range I
    · rcases hi with ⟨t, rfl⟩
      simpa [B, I', Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using congrFun hBu (Fin.castSucc t)
    · let Ii : Fin (r + 1) ↪ Fin n := Fin.Embedding.snoc I hi
      let b : Fin (r + 1) → F[X] := fun j => K i (J' j)
      have hupdate : B.updateRow (Fin.last r) b = K.submatrix Ii J' := by
        ext irow jcol : 2
        cases irow using Fin.lastCases <;> simp [B, I', Ii, b, Matrix.updateRow]
      have hd : Matrix.det (B.updateRow (Fin.last r) b) = 0 := by
        rw [hupdate]
        by_contra h
        exact hnotP_succ ⟨Ii, J', h⟩
      exact (det_updateRow_eq_sum_mul_adjugate_col (A := B) (i := Fin.last r) (b := b)).symm.trans hd

problems.name: ProximityGap.RS_jointAgreement_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt
problems.author: 손지연
problems.proof:
theorem RS_jointAgreement_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt {deg : ℕ} {domain : ι ↪ F} {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hδ : δ ≤ relativeUniqueDecodingRadius (ι := ι) (F := F)
      (C := ReedSolomon.code domain deg))
    (u : WordStack F (Fin 2) ι)
    (hS : (RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ).card > Fintype.card ι) :
    jointAgreement (C := ReedSolomon.code domain deg) (δ := δ) (W := u) := by
  classical
  set n : ℕ := Fintype.card ι
  set e : ℕ := Nat.floor (δ * n)
  set good : Finset F := RS_goodCoeffs (deg := deg) (domain := domain) u δ
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by
    simp [n]
  have hgood_card : good.card > n := by
    simpa [good, n] using hS
  by_cases hdeg_zero : deg = 0
  · subst hdeg_zero
    let S0 : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => u 0 i = 0 ∧ u 1 i = 0)
    have hcode0_zero : ∀ w ∈ (ReedSolomon.code domain 0 : Set (ι → F)), w = 0 := by
      simp [ReedSolomon.code_zero]
    have hzero_card :
        ∀ z ∈ good,
          n - e ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_rel : δᵣ(u 0 + z • u 1, ReedSolomon.code domain 0) ≤ δ := by
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2
      have hz_zero : δᵣ(u 0 + z • u 1, (0 : ι → F)) ≤ δ := by
        rw [Code.relCloseToCode_iff_relCloseToCodeword_of_minDist] at hz_rel
        rcases hz_rel with ⟨w, hwmem, hwdist⟩
        simpa [hcode0_zero w hwmem] using hwdist
      obtain ⟨Tz, hTz_card, hTz_agree⟩ :=
        (Code.relCloseToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
          (u := u 0 + z • u 1) (v := (0 : ι → F)) (δ := δ)).1 hz_zero
      have hTz_sub :
          Tz ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0) := by
        intro i hi
        simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using (hTz_agree i).1 hi
      exact le_trans hTz_card (Finset.card_le_card hTz_sub)
    have hsum_lower :
        good.card * (n - e) ≤
          good.sum (fun z => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card) := by
      simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using
        (Finset.sum_le_sum fun z hz => hzero_card z hz)
    have hsum_eq :
        good.sum (fun z => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ι => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card)
          =
        Finset.univ.sum (fun i : ι =>
            (good.filter (fun z : F => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card) := by
      simp only [Finset.card_filter]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hcount_bound :
        ∀ i : ι,
          (good.filter (fun z : F => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card
            ≤ if i ∈ S0 then good.card else 1 := by
      intro i
      by_cases hcommon : u 0 i = 0 ∧ u 1 i = 0
      · have hiS0 : i ∈ S0 := by
          simp [S0, hcommon]
        simp [hiS0, hcommon]
      · have hiS0 : i ∉ S0 := by
          simp [S0, hcommon]
        have hcard_le_one :
            (good.filter (fun z : F => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card ≤ 1 := by
          apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
          intro z1 hz1 z2 hz2
          have hz1_eq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz1).2
          have hz2_eq := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz2).2
          by_cases hu1 : u 1 i = 0
          · exact False.elim (hcommon ⟨by simpa [hu1] using hz1_eq, hu1⟩)
          · exact mul_right_cancel₀ hu1 (add_left_cancel (hz1_eq.trans hz2_eq.symm))
        exact by simpa [hiS0] using hcard_le_one
    have hsum_upper :
        Finset.univ.sum (fun i : ι => (good.filter (fun z : F => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card)
          ≤ S0.card * good.card + (n - S0.card) := by
      have hbound :
          Finset.univ.sum (fun i : ι =>
              (good.filter (fun z : F => u 0 i + z * u 1 i = 0)).card) ≤
            Finset.univ.sum (fun i : ι => if i ∈ S0 then good.card else 1) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcount_bound i)
      have hsum_bound :
          Finset.univ.sum (fun i : ι => if i ∈ S0 then good.card else 1)
            = S0.card * good.card + (n - S0.card) := by
        have hc : (Finset.univ.filter fun x : ι => x ∉ S0) = S0ᶜ := by ext x; simp
        simp [Finset.sum_ite, hc, n, Finset.card_compl]
      exact le_trans hbound (le_of_eq hsum_bound)
    have hS0_card_nat : n - e ≤ S0.card := by
      have hmain :
          good.card * (n - e) ≤ S0.card * good.card + (n - S0.card) := by
        exact (hsum_lower.trans_eq hsum_eq).trans hsum_upper
      by_contra hS0_small
      have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left good.card (show S0.card + 1 ≤ n - e by omega)
      have hs := Nat.sub_le n S0.card
      nlinarith
    have hS0_card :
        (1 - δ) * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) ≤ (S0.card : ℝ≥0) := by
      exact (Code.relDist_floor_bound_iff_complement_bound n S0.card δ).mp hS0_card_nat
    refine ⟨S0, hS0_card, (fun _ => 0), ?_⟩
    intro k
    refine ⟨(ReedSolomon.code domain 0).zero_mem, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    have hh := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    fin_cases k
    · simpa using hh.1.symm
    · simpa using hh.2.symm
  · by_cases hdeg_le : deg ≤ n
    · letI : NeZero deg := ⟨hdeg_zero⟩
      have hBW : 2 * e < n - deg + 1 := by
        simpa [n, e] using
          (RS_BW_bound_of_le_relUDR (deg := deg) (domain := domain) (δ := δ) hdeg_le hδ)
      have hgood_pos := lt_trans hn_pos hgood_card
      let P_x : Finset F := Finset.univ.map domain
      let P_y : Finset F := good
      haveI : Nonempty P_x := by
        apply Finset.Nonempty.to_subtype
        simp [P_x]
      haveI : Nonempty P_y := by
        apply Finset.Nonempty.to_subtype
        exact Finset.card_pos.mp hgood_pos
      have evalY_natDegree_le_degreeX (z : F) (f : F[X][Y]) :
          (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z f).natDegree ≤ Polynomial.Bivariate.degreeX f := by
        rw [ps_eval_y_eq_eval_x_swap, ps_eval_x_eq_map]
        exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_le.trans (Polynomial.Bivariate.natDegreeY_swap f).le
      have evalX_eval_eq_evalY_eval (x z : F) (f : F[X][Y]) :
          (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalX x f).eval z = (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z f).eval x := by
        simpa [ps_eval_x_eq_map, Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY, Polynomial.eval_map] using
          (Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply (p := f) (f := Polynomial.evalRingHom x) (r := Polynomial.C z))
      obtain ⟨A, B, hA0, hA_degX, hA_degY, hB_degX, hB_degY, hAB⟩ :=
        RS_exists_bivariate_AB_of_goodCoeffs_card_gt
          (deg := deg) (domain := domain) (δ := δ) hdeg_le hδ u hS
      let quot_x : F → F[X] := fun z =>
        if hz : z ∈ good then
          Classical.choose (RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs
            (deg := deg) (domain := domain) (δ := δ) u (z := z) hz)
        else 0
      let quot_y : F → F[X] := fun x =>
        Polynomial.C (u 0 (Function.invFun domain x)) +
          Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 (Function.invFun domain x))
      have h_card_Px : (⟨n, hn_pos⟩ : ℕ+) ≤ P_x.card := by
        simp [P_x, n]
      have h_card_Py : (⟨good.card, hgood_pos⟩ : ℕ+) ≤ P_y.card := by
        simp [P_y]
      have h_quot_x :
          ∀ z ∈ P_y,
            (quot_x z).natDegree ≤ (e + deg - 1) - e ∧
              Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z B = (quot_x z) * (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z A) := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_good : z ∈ good := by simpa [P_y] using hz
        let Pz : F[X] := Classical.choose
          (RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs (deg := deg)
            (domain := domain) (δ := δ) u (z := z) hz_good)
        have hPz :
            Pz.natDegree < deg ∧
              Δ₀(u 0 + z • u 1, Pz.eval ∘ domain) ≤ e := by
          simpa [Pz, e] using
            (Classical.choose_spec
              (RS_exists_Pz_of_mem_goodCoeffs
                (deg := deg) (domain := domain) (δ := δ) u (z := z) hz_good))
        have hquot_def : quot_x z = Pz := by
          simp [quot_x, hz_good, Pz]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hquot_def]
          have hp : Pz.natDegree < deg := hPz.1
          omega
        · let Dz : F[X] := Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z B - Pz * Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z A
          obtain ⟨Tz, hTz_card, hTz_agree⟩ :=
            (Code.closeToWord_iff_exists_agreementCols
              (u := u 0 + z • u 1) (v := Pz.eval ∘ domain) (e := e)).1 hPz.2
          have hDz_eval :
              ∀ x ∈ Tz.image domain, Dz.eval x = 0 := by
            intro x hx
            rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨i, hiTz, rfl⟩
            have hi_eq : u 0 i + z * u 1 i = Pz.eval (domain i) := by
              simpa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using (hTz_agree i).1 hiTz
            have heval := congrArg (fun p : F[X] => p.eval z) (hAB i)
            simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_C,
              Polynomial.eval_X, evalX_eval_eq_evalY_eval] at heval
            simpa only [Dz, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, sub_eq_zero, ← hi_eq] using heval
          have hDz_deg :
              Dz.natDegree ≤ e + deg - 1 := by
            apply (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
            apply max_le
            · exact (evalY_natDegree_le_degreeX z B).trans hB_degX
            · have hm := Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le (p := Pz) (q := Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z A)
              have ha : (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalY z A).natDegree ≤ e :=
                (evalY_natDegree_le_degreeX z A).trans hA_degX
              have hp : Pz.natDegree < deg := hPz.1
              omega
          have hdeg_lt :
              Dz.natDegree < (Tz.image domain).card := by
            rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ domain.injective]
            omega
          have hDz_zero : Dz = 0 := by
            exact
              Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero'
                (p := Dz) (s := Tz.image domain) hDz_eval hdeg_lt
          simpa [Dz, hquot_def, sub_eq_zero] using hDz_zero
      have h_quot_y :
          ∀ x ∈ P_x,
            (quot_y x).natDegree ≤ (e + 1) - e ∧
              Polynomial.Bivariate.evalX x B = (quot_y x) * (Polynomial.Bivariate.evalX x A) := by
        intro x hx
        rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨i, -, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have hlin : (Polynomial.C (u 0 i) + Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C (u 1 i) : F[X]).natDegree ≤ 1 :=
            (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
              (max_le (by simp) ((Polynomial.natDegree_mul_C_le
                (f := (Polynomial.X : F[X])) (a := u 1 i)).trans (by simp)))
          simpa [quot_y, Function.leftInverse_invFun domain.injective i] using hlin
        · simpa [quot_y, Function.leftInverse_invFun domain.injective i] using hAB i
      have h_le_1 :
          1 >
            ((((e + deg - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((⟨n, hn_pos⟩ : ℕ+) : ℚ)) +
              (((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((⟨good.card, hgood_pos⟩ : ℕ+) : ℚ))) := by
        change ((e + deg - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (n : ℚ) + ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / (good.card : ℚ) < 1
        have hnq : (0 : ℚ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos
        have hng : (n : ℚ) < good.card := by exact_mod_cast hgood_card
        have hf : ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / good.card < ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n :=
          div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by positivity) hnq hng
        have he : (e + deg - 1) + (e + 1) ≤ n := by omega
        have hle : ((e + deg - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n + ((e + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / n ≤ 1 := by
          rw [← add_div, div_le_iff₀ hnq, one_mul]
          exact_mod_cast he
        linarith
      obtain ⟨P, hBA, hP_degX, hP_degY, ⟨Q_x, hQx_card, hQx_sub, hQx_eval⟩, _⟩ :=
        polishchuk_spielman

          P_x P_y quot_x quot_y h_card_Px h_card_Py h_quot_x h_quot_y h_le_1
      have hP_degX' : Polynomial.Bivariate.degreeX P ≤ deg - 1 := by
        omega

      have hS0_card_nat : n - e ≤ S0.card := by

            S0.card = (S0.map domain).card := by symm; simp

        exact by simpa [S0, hcard_eq, n, e] using hQx_card
      have hS0_card :
          (1 - δ) * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ≥0) ≤ (S0.card : ℝ≥0) := by
        exact (Code.relDist_floor_bound_iff_complement_bound n S0.card δ).mp hS0_card_nat
      have hv_mem (j : ℕ) : ((P.coeff j).eval ∘ domain) ∈ ReedSolomon.code domain deg := by
        have hcoeff_deg_nat := le_trans (Polynomial.Bivariate.coeff_natDegree_le_degreeX P j) hP_degX'
        have hcoeff_deg : (P.coeff j).degree < deg := by

        simpa [Polynomial.mem_degreeLT] using hcoeff_deg
      refine ⟨S0, hS0_card, (fun k : Fin 2 => (P.coeff (k : ℕ)).eval ∘ domain), ?_⟩

        simpa [LinearCode.dim] using

problems.name: ps_coprime_case_constant
problems.author: 손지연
problems.proof:
lemma ps_coprime_case_constant {F : Type} [Field F]
    (a_x a_y b_x b_y : ℕ) (n_x n_y : ℕ+)
    (h_bx_ge_ax : b_x ≥ a_x) (h_by_ge_ay : b_y ≥ a_y)
    (A B : F[X][Y]) (hA0 : A ≠ 0) (hB0 : B ≠ 0) (hrel : IsRelPrime A B)
    (h_f_degX : a_x ≥ degreeX A) (h_g_degX : b_x ≥ degreeX B)
    (h_f_degY : a_y ≥ natDegreeY A) (h_g_degY : b_y ≥ natDegreeY B)
    (P_x P_y : Finset F) [Nonempty P_x] [Nonempty P_y]
    (quot_x quot_y : F → F[X])
    (h_card_Px : n_x ≤ P_x.card) (h_card_Py : n_y ≤ P_y.card)
    (h_quot_x : ∀ y ∈ P_y, (quot_x y).natDegree ≤ (b_x - a_x) ∧
      evalY y B = (quot_x y) * (evalY y A))
    (h_quot_y : ∀ x ∈ P_x, (quot_y x).natDegree ≤ (b_y - a_y) ∧
      evalX x B = (quot_y x) * (evalX x A))
    (h_le_1 : 1 > (b_x : ℚ) / (n_x : ℚ) + (b_y : ℚ) / (n_y : ℚ)) :
    degreeX A = 0 ∧ natDegreeY A = 0 := by
  classical
  set mY := natDegreeY A with hmY; set mX := degreeX A with hmX
  set RY := resultant B A b_y mY with hRY
  set RX := resultant (swap B) (swap A) b_x mX with hRX
  have hA0' : swap A ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hA0 (swap.injective (by simpa using h))
  have hRY0 : RY ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [RY, hRY, mY, hmY] using ps_resultant_ne_zero_of_is_rel_prime _ _ b_y
      (by simpa using h_g_degY) hA0 hrel
  have hRX0 : RX ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hRX, show mX = natDegreeY (swap A) from hmX.trans (ps_nat_degree_y_swap A).symm]
    simpa using ps_resultant_ne_zero_of_is_rel_prime _ _ b_x
      (by rw [ps_nat_degree_y_swap]; simpa using h_g_degX) hA0' (ps_is_rel_prime_swap hrel)
  have hcop : Pairwise fun x y : F ↦ IsCoprime (X - C x : F[X]) (X - C y) :=
    pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C fun _ _ h ↦ h
  have hprod_dvd_RY : (∏ x ∈ P_x, (X - C x) ^ mY) ∣ RY :=
    Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (fun _ _ _ _ hxy ↦ by simpa using (hcop hxy).pow) fun x hx ↦ by
      obtain ⟨hdegQ, hQ⟩ := h_quot_y x hx
      simpa [RY, hRY, mY, hmY] using ps_resultant_dvd_pow_eval_x _ _ _ _ b_y
        (by omega) (by simpa using h_g_degY) (by omega) hQ
  have hprod_dvd_RX : (∏ y ∈ P_y, (X - C y) ^ mX) ∣ RX :=
    Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime (fun _ _ _ _ hyy' ↦ by simpa using (hcop hyy').pow) fun y hy ↦ by
      obtain ⟨hdegQ, hQ⟩ := h_quot_x y hy
      simpa [RX, hRX, mX, hmX] using ps_resultant_dvd_pow_eval_y A B y (quot_x y) b_x
        (by omega) (by simpa using h_g_degX) (by omega) hQ
  have hdeg_prod (S : Finset F) (m : ℕ) :
      (∏ x ∈ S, (X - C x) ^ m).natDegree = m * S.card := by
    rw [natDegree_prod _ _ (fun x _ ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (X_sub_C_ne_zero x))]
    simp [natDegree_pow, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hRY_le := le_trans
    (by simpa [RY, hRY] using ps_nat_degree_resultant_le A B mY b_y)
    (Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_g_degX) (le_of_eq (Nat.mul_comm b_y (degreeX A))))
  have hRX_le : RX.natDegree ≤ mX * b_y + mY * b_x := by
    have hdeg' : RX.natDegree ≤ mX * degreeX (swap B) + b_x * degreeX (swap A) := by
      simpa [RX, hRX] using ps_nat_degree_resultant_le (swap A) (swap B) mX b_x
    apply le_trans hdeg' (Nat.add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · rw [ps_degree_x_swap B]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by simpa using h_g_degY)
    · rw [ps_degree_x_swap A]; exact le_of_eq (Nat.mul_comm b_x (natDegreeY A))
  have hmy_le_D : mY * (n_x : ℕ) ≤ mX * b_y + mY * b_x :=
    le_trans (le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_card_Px)
      ((hdeg_prod P_x mY).symm ▸ natDegree_le_of_dvd hprod_dvd_RY hRY0)) (by linarith)
  have hmx_le_D : mX * (n_y : ℕ) ≤ mX * b_y + mY * b_x :=
    le_trans (le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h_card_Py)
      ((hdeg_prod P_y mX).symm ▸ natDegree_le_of_dvd hprod_dvd_RX hRX0)) hRX_le
  suffices mX * b_y + mY * b_x = 0 by
    constructor
    · change mX = 0
      have : mX * (n_y : ℕ) ≤ 0 := by omega
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero this)).resolve_right (Nat.ne_of_gt n_y.pos)
    · change mY = 0
      have : mY * (n_x : ℕ) ≤ 0 := by omega
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero this)).resolve_right (Nat.ne_of_gt n_x.pos)
  have hcross : b_x * (n_y : ℕ) + (n_x : ℕ) * b_y < (n_x : ℕ) * (n_y : ℕ) := by
    have hx : (0 : ℚ) < n_x := by exact_mod_cast n_x.pos
    have hy : (0 : ℚ) < n_y := by exact_mod_cast n_y.pos
    rw [div_add_div _ _ hx.ne' hy.ne'] at h_le_1
    exact_mod_cast (div_lt_one (mul_pos hx hy)).mp h_le_1
  have hx := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b_x * (n_y : ℕ)) hmy_le_D
  have hy := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (b_y * (n_x : ℕ)) hmx_le_D
  by_contra hn
  have hlt := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcross (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
  nlinarith only [hx, hy, hlt]

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, T, hb⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n+1), u (n+2), u (n+3))
  have hf : Set.MapsTo f Set.univ (Set.Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T)) := by
    intro n _
    exact ⟨⟨(hb n).1, (hb (n+1)).1, (hb (n+2)).1, (hb (n+3)).1⟩,
      ⟨(hb n).2, (hb (n+1)).2, (hb (n+2)).2, (hb (n+3)).2⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨i, _, j, _, hij, heq⟩ :=
    Set.infinite_univ.exists_ne_map_eq_of_mapsTo hf (Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  have hp : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
    · exact ⟨i,j,h,heq⟩
    · exact ⟨j,i,h,heq.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,heq⟩ := hp
  simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
  have hs : ∀ m, u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · interval_cases m
        · simpa using heq.1
        · exact heq.2.1
        · exact heq.2.2.1
        · exact heq.2.2.2
      · have hk (k : ℕ) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk4 : k ≤ 4) :
            u (i+m-k) = u (j+m-k) := by
          simpa only [Nat.add_sub_assoc (by omega : k ≤ m)] using ih (m-k) (by omega)
        apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i+m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j+m) (by omega)).1,
          hk 1 (by decide) (by decide), hk 2 (by decide) (by decide),
          hk 3 (by decide) (by decide), hk 4 (by decide) (by decide)]
  refine ⟨i,j-i,Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij,?_⟩
  intro n hn
  convert (hs (n-i)).symm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
