theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have change_digit (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) =
        digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then e j else d j) * 10 ^ (j : ℕ)) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (d j * 10 ^ (j : ℕ) +
            if j = i then (e i - d i) * 10 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : j = i
        · subst j; simp; ring
        · simp [hj]
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp
  have hd := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2
  have he := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2
  simp only [change_digit] at hd he
  have hsum := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  have h₇ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    convert dvd_sub hsum (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)) using 1
    simp [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    ring
  intro i
  have hmul : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    have hh := dvd_sub (dvd_add (he i) (hd i)) h₇
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring
  have hp : Prime (7 : ℤ) := by norm_num
  have hn : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro hc
    have hh := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hc
    norm_num at hh
  have hh := (hp.dvd_mul.mp hmul).resolve_right hn
  simpa only [neg_sub] using dvd_neg.mpr hh

theorem putnam_1988_a2
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : f = fun x ↦ Real.exp (x ^ 2)) :
    ((True) : Prop ) ↔
    (∃ a b : ℝ,
      a < b ∧
      ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ,
        (∃ x ∈ Ioo a b, g x ≠ 0) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℝ g (Ioo a b) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, deriv (fun y ↦ f y * g y) x = (deriv f x) * (deriv g x))  := by
  subst f
  simp only [true_iff]
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp x * Real.sqrt (2*x-1)
  have hg (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (1:ℝ) 2) :
      HasDerivAt g (Real.exp x * Real.sqrt (2*x-1) + Real.exp x / Real.sqrt (2*x-1)) x := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt (2*x-1) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [hx.1])).ne'
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 2*t-1) 2 x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul 2).sub_const 1
    convert (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).mul (hlin.sqrt (by linarith [hx.1])) using 1 <;>
      dsimp [g] <;> field_simp [hs] <;> ring
  refine ⟨1,2,by norm_num,g,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨3/2,by norm_num,?_⟩
    dsimp [g]
    positivity
  · intro x hx
    exact (hg x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (2*x-1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [hx.1])
    have hf := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).exp
    change deriv ((fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y^2)) * g) x = _
    rw [(hf.mul (hg x hx)).deriv, hf.deriv, (hg x hx).deriv]
    dsimp [g]

  (hcolorsrows : ∀ k, (∑ l, (if (colors k l = 0) then 1 else 0)) = n / 2)
  (hcolorscols : ∀ l, (∑ k, (if (colors k l = 0) then 1 else 0)) = n / 2) :

      exact_mod_cast Nat.mul_div_cancel' (even_iff_two_dvd.mp hn')

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have missing (A : Set S) (hA : A ∉ P) : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hPS ⟨A, hA, by simpa only [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty] using h⟩
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := missing A h.1
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := missing Aᶜ h.2
    apply hPP U hU V hV
    apply Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp
    exact (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr hAV).mono_left
      (Set.disjoint_right.mp (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr hAU))
  classical
  have hcard : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro A hA
      exact Finset.mem_compl.mpr (fun hAc => hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc (Set.inter_compl_self A))
    · intro A hA
      exact (h_subset_or_compl A).resolve_left (Finset.mem_compl.mp hA)
    · intro A _; exact compl_compl A
    · intro A _; exact compl_compl A
  have hsum : P.card + P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simpa only [← hcard, Fintype.card_set] using Finset.card_compl_add_card P
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos
  have hpow := pow_succ 2 (Fintype.card S - 1)
  rw [show Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S by omega] at hpow
  omega

    (P_def : ∀ f, P f ↔ ∃ x y, f x = y ∧ f y = x ∧ deriv f x * deriv f y = 1)
    (α : ℝ) :
    P (fun t ↦ α * t ^ 2 + α * t + 1 / 24) ↔ α ∈ (({2 / 3, 3 / 2, (13 + √601) / 12, (13 - √601) / 12}) : Set ℝ )  := by
  have hd (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun t : ℝ => α*t^2+α*t+1/24) x = 2*α*x+α := by
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul α).add
      ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul α)).add_const (1/24)).deriv using 1 <;> ring
  rw [P_def]
  simp only [hd, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 601)^2 = 601 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have back (hp : 6*α^2-13*α-18=0) :
      ∃ x y : ℝ, α*x^2+α*x+1/24=y ∧ α*y^2+α*y+1/24=x ∧
        (2*α*x+α)*(2*α*y+α)=1 := by
    have ha : α ≠ 0 := by intro hh; subst α; norm_num at hp
    let x := (-1-α)/(2*α)
    have hx : α*x^2+α*x+1/24=x := by
      dsimp [x]
      field_simp [ha]
      nlinarith only [hp]
    refine ⟨x,x,hx,hx,?_⟩
    dsimp [x]
    field_simp [ha]
    <;> ring
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,y,hx,hy,hprod⟩
    have ha : α ≠ 0 := by intro hh; subst α; norm_num at hprod
    have hxy : x=y := by
      by_contra hn
      have hf : (x-y)*(α*(x+y+1)+1)=0 := by linear_combination hx-hy
      have hf' := (mul_eq_zero.mp hf).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hn)
      have hz : (2*α*x+α)+(2*α*y+α)=-2 := by linear_combination 2*hf'
      have hsame : 2*α*x+α=2*α*y+α := by
        nlinarith only [hprod, sq_nonneg ((2*α*x+α)-(2*α*y+α)), hz, sq_nonneg ((2*α*x+α)+1)]
      apply hn
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)≠0) ha)
      linarith only [hsame]
    rw [← hxy] at hx hprod
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hprod with hz | hz
    · have hp : 6*α^2-13*α+6=0 := by
        linear_combination 6*(2*α*x+α-1)*hz -24*α*hx
      have hf : (α-2/3)*(α-3/2)=0 := by nlinarith only [hp]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with hh | hh
      · exact Or.inl (by linarith only [hh])
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by linarith only [hh]))
    · have hp : 6*α^2-13*α-18=0 := by
        linear_combination 6*(2*α*x+α-3)*hz -24*α*hx
      have hf : (α-(13+Real.sqrt 601)/12)*(α-(13-Real.sqrt 601)/12)=0 := by
        nlinarith only [hp,hs]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with hh | hh
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (by linarith only [hh])))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by linarith only [hh])))
  · rintro (hh | hh | hh | hh)
    · subst α; exact ⟨1/4,1/4,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num⟩
    · subst α; exact ⟨-1/6,-1/6,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num⟩
    · apply back; rw [hh]; nlinarith only [hs]
    · apply back; rw [hh]; nlinarith only [hs]

theorem putnam_1970_b5
(ramp : ℤ → (ℝ → ℝ))
(ramp_def : ramp = fun (n : ℤ) => (fun (x : ℝ) => if x ≤ -n then (-n : ℝ) else (if -n < x ∧ x ≤ n then x else (n : ℝ))))
(F : ℝ → ℝ)
: Continuous F ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, Continuous ((ramp n) ∘ F))  := by
  have hr (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ramp n x =
      if x ≤ -(n : ℝ) then -(n : ℝ) else
        if -(n : ℝ) < x ∧ x ≤ n then x else n := by simp [ramp_def]
  constructor
  · intro h n
    have he : ramp n = fun x : ℝ => min (max x (-(n : ℝ))) n := by
      funext x
      rw [hr]
      have hn := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n
      simp only [min_def, max_def]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> linarith
    rw [he]
    exact ((continuous_id.max continuous_const).min continuous_const).comp h
  · intro h
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro a
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (|F a| + ε)
    have hleft : -(n : ℝ) < F a := by linarith [neg_abs_le (F a)]
    have hright : F a ≤ (n : ℝ) := by linarith [le_abs_self (F a)]
    have ha : ramp n (F a) = F a := by
      rw [hr, if_neg (not_le.mpr hleft), if_pos ⟨hleft,hright⟩]
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hclose⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (h n).continuousAt ε hε
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hc : |ramp n (F x) - F a| < ε := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.dist_eq, ha] using hclose hx
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    rw [hr] at hc
    split_ifs at hc with hlo hmid
    · have hl := (abs_lt.mp hc).1
      linarith [neg_abs_le (F a)]
    · exact hc
    · have hu := (abs_lt.mp hc).2
      linarith [le_abs_self (F a)]

problems.proof:
theorem putnam_1991_b1
  (m S : ℤ → ℤ)
  (A : ℤ)
  (a : ℕ → ℤ)
  (hm : ∀ n, 0 ≤ n → (m n) ^ 2 ≤ n ∧ (∀ m' : ℤ, m' ^ 2 ≤ n → m' ≤ m n))
  (hS : ∀ n, 0 ≤ n → S n = n - (m n) ^ 2)
  (ha : a 0 = A ∧ (∀ k, a (k + 1) = a k + S (a k)))
  (hA : A > 0) :
  (∃ (K : ℕ) (c : ℕ), ∀ k ≥ K, a k = c) ↔ A ∈ (({A : ℤ | ∃ x > 0, A = x ^ 2}) : Set ℤ ) := by
  have h_nonneg : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa [ha.1] using hA.le
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [ha.2 k, hS (a k) ih]
      linarith only [ih, (hm (a k) ih).1]
  have h_S_pos : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ n → (∀ (t : ℤ), n ≠ t ^ 2) → S n ≥ 1 := by
    intro n hn hnotsquare
    rw [hS n hn]
    have hb := (hm n hn).1
    have hne := hnotsquare (m n)
    omega
  have h_no_new_squares (k : ℕ) (hk : ∀ t : ℤ, a k ≠ t ^ 2) :
      ∀ t : ℤ, a (k+1) ≠ t ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht
    have hn := h_nonneg k
    obtain ⟨hlo, hmax⟩ := hm (a k) hn
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ m (a k) := hmax 0 (by simpa using hn)
    have hceil : a k < (m (a k) + 1) ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hh
      have hh' := hmax (m (a k) + 1) (le_of_not_gt hh)
      omega
    have heq : t ^ 2 = 2 * a k - m (a k) ^ 2 := by
      rw [ha.2 k, hS (a k) hn] at ht
      linarith only [ht]
    have hstrict : m (a k) ^ 2 < a k := lt_of_le_of_ne hlo (Ne.symm (hk _))
    have hlow : m (a k) < |t| := (sq_lt_sq₀ hm0 (abs_nonneg t)).mp (by
      rw [sq_abs]
      nlinarith only [heq, hstrict])
    have hhigh : |t| < m (a k) + 2 :=
      (sq_lt_sq₀ (abs_nonneg t) (by omega : 0 ≤ m (a k) + 2)).mp (by
        rw [sq_abs]
        nlinarith only [heq, hceil])
    have habs : |t| = m (a k) + 1 := by omega
    have hp : 2 * a k = 2 * m (a k) ^ 2 + 2 * m (a k) + 1 := by
      have hs := sq_abs t
      rw [habs] at hs
      nlinarith only [hs, heq]
    omega
  have h_strict_increasing (hnot : ∀ t : ℤ, A ≠ t ^ 2) (k : ℕ) : a k < a (k+1) := by
    have hn : ∀ k, ∀ t : ℤ, a k ≠ t ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simpa [ha.1] using hnot
      | succ k ih => exact h_no_new_squares k ih
    have hp := h_S_pos (a k) (h_nonneg k) (hn k)
    rw [ha.2 k]
    omega
  constructor
  · intro hevent
    by_contra hn
    have hnot : ∀ t : ℤ, A ≠ t ^ 2 := by
      intro t ht
      apply hn
      refine ⟨|t|, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply abs_pos.mpr
        intro ht0
        subst t
        norm_num at ht
        omega
      · simpa only [sq_abs] using ht
    obtain ⟨K, c, hconst⟩ := hevent
    have hinc := h_strict_increasing hnot K
    linarith [hconst K le_rfl, hconst (K + 1) (Nat.le_succ K)]
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩
    have hS0 : S A = 0 := by
      rw [hS A (le_of_lt hA)]
      have hlo := (hm A (le_of_lt hA)).1
      have hge : x ≤ m A := (hm A (le_of_lt hA)).2 x (le_of_eq hx'.symm)
      nlinarith
    have hconstant (k : ℕ) : a k = A := by
      induction k with
      | zero => exact ha.1
      | succ k ih => rw [ha.2 k, ih, hS0, add_zero]
    refine ⟨0, A.toNat, ?_⟩
    intro k _
    rw [hconstant]
    simp [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hA)]

: {n : ℤ | ∃ A B C : ℤ, A ≥ 0 ∧ B ≥ 0 ∧ C ≥ 0 ∧ A^3 + B^3 + C^3 - 3*A*B*C = n} = (({n : ℤ | n ≥ 0 ∧ ¬Int.ModEq 9 n 3 ∧ ¬Int.ModEq 9 n 6}) : Set ℤ ) := by
